rows.en:
(Maybe today I'll invite Michel
to Silver Moon or something.)

Hey, Michel!
If you're free, want to stop by Silver Moon?

Sorry, \p.
Actually, I've got plans after this.

I see. Then that can't be helped...
But what plans, exactly?

Don't ask such a tactless question.
A date, obviously.
I-I see...

rows.en:

See you, \p.

then.)

rows.en:
Nah, something suddenly came up at my part-time job.
I don't think I can get out of it.
Huh~, that's rough.

Sorry about that.
Ask me again some other time.
I'll do that.

(Today I'm going to have fun

I'm not really in the mood
for shopping at Folmo...

Because I might run into Klan.
The Zentradi-sized one...
rows.notes: Both genders. Klan in her full-size (macronized) form.

rows.en:
The last time I ran into her here, I was on a date
with an older lady. It was the worst.
She came chasing after me at that size, you know?

Geez, it's no laughing matter
when it actually happens to you.
rows.notes: Both genders; answers the player's laugh.

rows.en:
...Well, enough about Klan.
Shall we go enjoy some shopping?

Sorry, \p.
I just remembered something I have to do...
rows.notes: x4, both genders. He spots Klan (player 'Ah!', Michel 'Gah!') and bolts.

rows.en: I'll be taking my leave for today.
Ah, hey, Michel...
rows.notes: x3: the player, both genders (the female scene uses it once too).

rows.en: (Aww, Michel went home...)

(He didn't have to run off like he was
fleeing from Klan-senpai...)

Ah, wait up, \p!
